ev.q: Only facility A employees were found to have blood lead levels above the CDC reference level of 5 μ g/dL.
More facility B employees reported wearing gloves all or most of the time while at work than did facility A employees.
Nonprocessing surfaces at facility A were contaminated with cadmium (nine of 12) and lead (11 of 12)
All participating employees at both facilities had both cadmium and lead on their hands after washing them at the end of their shift.
More facility B employees reported wearing gloves all or most of the time while at work than did facility A employees.
NIOSH evaluated facility A over 3 days in August 2015 and facility B over 2 days in July 2017.

methods_quotes.q: One sample per day over 3 days for facility A, and one sample per day over 2 days for facility B.
Some participants at facility A elected not to participate in every part of the evaluation.
